summary:
Builder 2's step is finished: the plan's [11] slices 3, 4 and 5. TimingStrike (with L4's O13 combo rule and O14 live score) and HoldZone were built on 18 Nov. This session resumed from my notes after the usage pause and built slice 5:
- src/shared/Minigames/PrecisionTrace.luau, ported expression by expression from the v2 prototype, with the view (credit, coveredRuns and runningScore), feedback, an exported edgeToPanelInfo and an exported measures(P, samples).
- tests/fixtures/Edges.luau: the nine prototype blades as round-trip literals, generated once from Blades.luau. Cost.X08_EDGE is Edges.zigzag.
- PT_TRAVEL_MAX_MS is now read by the Definitions spec.
- tests/Minigames/PrecisionTrace.spec.luau, plus two Properties rows.

The build reproduces E-S3.5 exactly (the golden, the fallback, the tilted grip and all nine blade-table rows) and matches the prototype bit for bit on all nine blades.

I ran a mutation pass on a .git-free copy under the SAFETY rules (120 s per mutant, job objects, one Lune process at a time). The first pass caught 76 of 84 mutants. The five real gaps got new cases in the TimingStrike, HoldZone and PrecisionTrace specs, and the final pass caught 82 of 85, with none hung and no process left. The 3 survivors are explained: two are equivalent on the shipped data, and one targets the generic Properties row, while the family spec pins the exact value.

Two other fixes: I trimmed the trace test cost from 877 ms to 493 ms, and normalized builder 1's flagged CRLF files to LF.

M4's quick share is 0.71–0.72 s by the runner (14–21 % load). M4-notes has a B2 section, and M4-handoff has the Builder 2 section of exact old → new SPEC edits (all 10 old blocks checked against SPEC.md). verify --quick is green: 788 pass, 0 fail, at 37–63 % load with the other team's 3–5 Lune processes running.

Builder 1's report checks out against the worktree: 770 pass before, plus my 18 fast cases, 4 slow ones and 1 new file. The lead's two Rojo serve processes on the main tree were not touched, and no process of mine is running.
testsAdded: - §16.22's 27 constants equal the prototype's; Edges = Blades number for number; Cost.X08_EDGE is Edges.zigzag
- T-MG-13 E-S3.5 golden: arming source, path 337 points, L 3.3526, 11180/12180 ms, 0xF0B5CD03; fallback 402 points, 0x405C00EA; tilted grip gives the same source
- E-S3.5's blade table, all nine rows (sides, source points, E, tolerance, path points, L, travel N/H)

- the edge hand-off: one side, degenerate chains, the noSides/flat/short/tooLong reasons, shrink steps, tolerance doubling (saw 0.128, zigzag 0.512), the cross-axis clamp on a 1-stud blade, 301 points simplified, fallback thresholds 0.39996/0.40002 u
- the worst source (256-point sine at the length bound): 860 points, L 8.564, 28560 ms
- the travel clamp (6 s floor, 30 s cap); the path stays in the quantized panel
- tick rules on an exact straight path: accuracy at the core and at halfWidth, pace bands, the 250 ms gap (240/250/251 and the held cursor), tick 1's previous cursor
- coverage: the pacer covers every bin; scribbling past the speed gate covers none; idle and lifted score 0

- checks at their thresholds: PtSparse 200/199, PtTeleport (3 jumps, 0.25 u strict, 41 ms, lifted), PtTooPrecise (40/39 samples, 13 vs 14 /16384), PtTooSmooth (150/149 triplets, dt 9/10/40/41, jerk 2/16384), all four in byte order
- the view: pacer, cursor, credit, coveredRuns decode to the covered bins, runningScore formula so far and equal to the score at the end, views change nothing
- feedback: GrindStart/Stop, OnPath/OffPath, PaceWarn ±1 with re-arm, Coverage 25/50/75/100 each once at the reaching tick, End once, the shared frozen NONE
- live = replay, sized (PROP_N_FAST quick, PROP_N under t.slow)
- prototype parity bit for bit, sized: sides, source and info, path arrays, L/speed/travel/hash, unquantized accSum/paceSum/nCovered, score, breakdown, flags, measures
tests/Minigames/TimingStrike.spec.luau: new case 'no span opens before GO: M = T_1 for an early first target' (slice 3's other 12 cases from 18 Nov)
tests/Minigames/HoldZone.spec.luau: new case 'S.hist is perception only'; the view case adds the live score from the first ticks (slice 4's other cases from 18 Nov)

tests/Minigames/Properties.spec.luau: PrecisionTrace session row and edge hand-off row (P-DET, P-NOMUT, P-TOTAL on degenerate chains, P-FINITE, P-RANGE), both sized; TimingStrike and HoldZone rows from slices 3-4
tests/Definitions/MinigameFamilies.spec.luau now reads PT_TRAVEL_MAX_MS from PrecisionTrace ([5.2]; TS_PERFECT_CORE_MIN_MS since slice 3)

Edges fixture: 9 edges, 629 chain points. Tilted grip axis (-0.49999999999999994, 0.8660254037844387); zigzag chain length 153.03777311500602.
deviations: TimingStrike.push returns the Miss of each span its press closes, before its Strike or Whiff. The plan's [3.8] lists Miss under advance only. A Miss is stamped T_i + M and End T_N + M.

PrecisionTraceView gains runningScore (a Types change). §12.2 shows a live score for every step and O14 defines the trace's, but §6.10 and the plan's [3.1] list no such field. It ends equal to the score.

edgeToPanelInfo and measures(P, samples) are exported. The plan keeps the diagnostics private, but tests can only reach exported functions and T-MG-10 needs the measures. FamilyModule.checks still returns flags only.
Cost.X08_EDGE is the whole zigzag edge with its grip ({name, chains, gripPoint, gripAxis}), not a bare EdgeChain: generating from it needs the grip.
Edges literals are Luau's shortest round-trip literals (at most 17 significant digits; the plan says '17-digit literals'), each checked to read back to the same double.

The check that Edges equals Blades lives in PrecisionTrace.spec, because tests/FixtureSet is outside L1's file list. It depends on this machine's libm for sabre (^), flamberge (sin) and tilted (sin, cos).
generate raises an error when the fallback edge cannot fit the travel bound (pacer under about 0.14 u/s; the MVP's is 0.30 or more). The prototype would fail on a nil index there.
The path's P-RANGE holds before quantization. After round(·16384) the bounds are 819..48333 by 819..15565 sixteen-thousandths (0.04999 to 2.95001).

Feedback is defined as built (G7): the trace's OnPath/OffPath fire on grinding ticks only, PaceWarn only on the band, Coverage at the tick that reaches each quarter, End at leadInMs + travelMs, GrindStart/Stop from push; the trace has no Go.
Not in the plan: I ran a mutation pass for slices 3–5 under the SAFETY rules, and added five cases to close the gaps it found.

Test-cost trims: raw test sources are random walks of at most 12 points, the Properties trace records are capped at 400, the 10 ms cadence is gone from the human sampler, and a string-free deep compare runs before A.deepEq.
Builder 1 flagged CRLF line endings in HoldZone.spec and Properties.spec; I normalized them to LF (content unchanged).
Today's brief was a resume: slices 3–4 were built on 18 Nov before the pause, and this session built slice 5, the mutation pass and the write-up.
openIssues: For the lead: O13 (the combo) and O14 (the live score) use L4's defaults and are marked **[Decision to confirm]** in the three family modules' headers. The handoff adds their §17.1 rows; L4 numbered them O13/O14, leaving room for an O12 from the shift fix.
For the lead: apply the Builder 2 handoff section after the shift fix's commit. §6.11's G15 text goes with slice 7's §6.2 / §12.5 Recorder edits (D4), which are not written yet.

Quiet timing still to do (L2): the final verify --quick ran at 37–63 % load with 3–5 heavy Lune processes from the other team (39.42 s by the runner). M4's quick share after slice 5 is 0.71–0.72 s at 14–21 % load, which leaves about 2.3 s of the 3 s share for slices 6–8.

For builder 3 (slices 6–7):
- Timeline gets U_MAX and V_MAX from PrecisionTrace.PT_PANEL_ASPECT and PT_FIXED_POINT.
- The facade maps an edge with PrecisionTrace.edgeToPanel(PrecisionTrace.sidesFromChains(edge.chains, edge.gripPoint, edge.gripAxis), edge.gripPoint, edge.gripAxis, params.pacerSpeed).
- PrecisionTrace.advance already stops at the latest pushed sample.

For builder 4 (slices 8–10):
- Trace bots use pacerArc, pointAt, PT_FIXED_POINT (the prototype's PT.Q), PT_PANEL_ASPECT (PT.PANEL_W) and PT_EVAL_MS.
- HoldZone perception is S.hist = { T = {}, C = {} }, filled per tick by advance; it provably changes no result.
- T-MG-10 reads each run's meanDev and meanJerk from PrecisionTrace.measures.
- T-PERF-02 should generate on Cost.X08_EDGE and on sources the hand-off bounded: unbounded sources cost up to 25 ms per generate.

Findings to carry:
- luau-lsp accepts the wider family modules as Types.FamilyModule (width subtyping), relevant to G13 and §17.2's S1 row.
- A HoldZone down after the last tick's start is never integrated (as in the prototype; no score effect).
- The trace's cross-axis clamp never binds on the nine reference blades.

The three mutants left uncaught are explained, not test gaps: HoldZone's fire-decay grouping (identical doubles at fireDecayMs 600), the key pointer with < at a key's exact time (exact by the Sterbenz lemma), and a ×1.5 on view.coverage run against Properties alone (the family spec catches it).

Kept in my folder for re-runs, which the lead can delete after the M4 commit: m4-b2/mutwt (a .git-free copy equal to the worktree at 02:40) and m4-b2/work scripts (genedges, ptprobe, ptcost, ptcost2, groupcheck, mutate_b2.py, bounded.py, casetimes). The scratch folder loses week-old files.
